name: KiCad Autorouter
description: Negotiated-congestion autorouting for 2–32 layer KiCad PCBs.
description_full: An external-process IPC plugin for routing ordinary KiCad PCBs. It provides preflight graph and clearance-map inspection, scoped routing and unrouting, per-layer direction policies, negotiated congestion, through vias, cancellation, and explicit application as an undoable KiCad operation. Always inspect generated copper and run KiCad DRC before fabrication.
